question.question: What is the name of the Disney Cruise Line ship that debuted from Fort Lauderdale in late 2025 as a sister ship to the Disney Wish?

replacement.question: On what date in 2025 did the Disney Destiny set sail on its maiden voyage from Fort Lauderdale?

reason: Both test the Disney Destiny maiden voyage from Fort Lauderdale in November 2025. #2567 retains the precise calendar date; #1398 gives the same launch event in reverse. Learning the complete event for #2567 answers #1398 without a new fact.

sources.locator: November 10, 2025 article; sister-ship paragraph and final maiden-voyage paragraph
sources.evidence: Disney Destiny, sister to Wish and Treasure, launches November 20, 2025 from Fort Lauderdale.

optionAssessment: Disney Destiny is the named launch ship.
Disney Legend is not the named vessel.
Disney Aurora is not the named vessel.
Disney Europa is not the named vessel.
challenge: Checked that the Fort Lauderdale launch and Wish sister-ship clues refer to Destiny; no distractor is an alternate name. Retire redundant launch identification and retain exact-date version.
